mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains the execution and verification foundation.

findings.detail: PR #1344 passes exact-head core CI (295 tests plus 8 subtests in 7.27 seconds) and the fail-closed gate. GitHub reports mergeable=true, draft=true and merged=false.

Despite adding a push trigger for safety/** and fix/** branches and a read-only push-noop job, the PR branch's own push event run 40947250141 still reports failure with zero jobs. This suggests the branch-only workflow change did not govern the observed run, but no workflow-evaluation trace exists to establish why.

interpretation: PR #1344 is a tested safety proposal, not a demonstrated fix for the zero-job anomaly. Its code is least-privilege and has no merge command, but the observed push run remains unexplained. Do not merge solely on the assumption that the mitigation works; preserve the root-cause uncertainty and require post-merge verification if approved.
